# Load Libraries

```{r}
library("tidyr")
library("tidyverse")
library("readr")
library("dplyr")
library("ggplot2")

```

# Load Data

```{r}
# Load the merged, tidy data
merged_final <- read_tsv("../data/03_merged_final.tsv")

# Take a quick look at the structure
glimpse(merged_final)
```

# Analyse Data

```{r}
merged_prepared <- merged_final |>
  mutate(
    disease_status = factor(`disease status`),
    day = factor(day),
    gender = factor(gender),
    neutrophil_proportion = as.numeric(`neutrophil proportion`)
  )

# Filter to day 1 samples only
merged_day1 <- merged_prepared |>
  filter(day == "D1")

# Check how many samples per disease group at day 1
merged_day1 |>
  count(disease_status)
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
merged_day1 |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = disease_status,
    y = expression,
    fill = disease_status
  )) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.8, alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ Gene_ID, scales = "free_y", nrow = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "healthy" = "#4DAF4A",
      "sepsis nonsurvivor" = "#E41A1C",
      "sepsis survivor" = "#377EB8"
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Gene expression (Day 1) by disease status ",
    x = "Disease status",
    y = "Expression",
    fill = "Disease status"
  )
```

```{r}
# Filter to only sepsis samples
sepsis_day1 <- merged_prepared |>
  filter(day == "D1" & disease_status != "healthy")

# Check group counts
sepsis_day1 |> count(disease_status)
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
ggplot(sepsis_day1, aes(
    x = disease_status,
    y = expression,
    fill = disease_status
)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.8, alpha = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~ Gene_ID, scales = "free_y", nrow = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "sepsis nonsurvivor" = "#E41A1C",
      "sepsis survivor" = "#377EB8"
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Gene expression on day 1 by survival status",
    x = "Survival status",
    y = "Expression",
    fill = "Survival status"
  )
```

```{r}
survival_summary <- sepsis_day1 |>
  group_by(Gene_ID, disease_status) |>
  summarise(
    mean = mean(expression),
    sd = sd(expression),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

survival_summary
```

```{r}
library(broom)
library(purrr)

survival_tests <- sepsis_day1 |>
  group_by(Gene_ID) |>
  group_modify(~{
    test <- t.test(expression ~ disease_status, data = .x)
    tidy(test)
  }) |>
  ungroup()

survival_tests
```

```{r}
library(stringr)

# pivot summary to wide form
summary_wide <- survival_summary |>
  select(Gene_ID, disease_status, mean) |>
  mutate(
    disease_status = str_replace_all(disease_status, " ", "_")
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = disease_status,
    values_from = mean,
    names_prefix = "mean_"
  )

# join with t-test results
survival_results <- survival_tests |>
  left_join(summary_wide, by = "Gene_ID") |>
  mutate(
    diff_nonsurvivor_minus_survivor =
      mean_sepsis_nonsurvivor - mean_sepsis_survivor,
    p_adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")
  ) |>
  arrange(p_adj)

survival_results
```

```{r}
ggplot(survival_results, aes(
    x = reorder(Gene_ID, diff_nonsurvivor_minus_survivor),
    y = diff_nonsurvivor_minus_survivor,
    fill = p_adj < 0.05
)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Expression difference (nonsurvivor - survivor)",
    x = "Gene",
    y = "Mean difference",
    fill = "Significant (FDR < 0.05)"
  )
```
